trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Leave the last page of the journal for this one. Once the other 54 stamps are in your PS5 list, the platinum follows on its own.

steps.text: Complete the other 54 base game trophies offline.
If one is outstanding, compare this journal with the PS5 trophy list.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: My first entry starts with Jason. Let his opening assignment finish before checking the trophy list.

steps.text: Follow Jason through Gone Fishing from the opening sequence.
Finish the mission normally for the automatic unlock.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: This stamp lands at the turn of the page. Before you cross into the next chapter, check the balcony note and keep a separate save.

steps.text: Make a manual save before leaving the first chapter and take Lucia’s optional balcony meditation.
Advance into What’s in the Bag? to register the chapter trophy.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: File this under Chapter 2, even though the stamp arrives in the next chapter. The asterisks belong to the PSN title.

steps.text: Clear the remaining Chapter 2 story missions and start Welcome to Vice City.
Use the PSN chapter number if cross-checking the log against GameTrek.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Give the chapter stamp a little room to arrive. It is normal to be two missions into the next section before it appears.

steps.text: Wrap up Chapter 3 and play Ocean Beach, then Another Life.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Save a slot at the chapter boundary for your own record. The last Chapter 4 mission awards the stamp without a separate task.

steps.text: Stay on the main route until Starting From Zero is finished.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: I keep the cleanup pages for after the credits. The finale earns this gold and you can return to unfinished work in free roam.

steps.text: Complete the last main mission, the trigger specified in the PSN description.
Resume free roam afterward for any unfinished checklists.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Put this stamp in the middle of the Chapter 2 page. It belongs to the main route and requires no detour.

steps.text: Follow the Chapter 2 story markers until Breakfast Run opens, then finish the mission.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: This is the Chapter 3 story stamp. I track the optional vault jobs on their own page because they have a different counter.

steps.text: Complete the main mission The Cartel Heist during Chapter 3.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Keep moving through Chapter 4 for this stamp. The mission itself is the whole trigger.

steps.text: Play through Child’s Play and let the story completion register.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: I mark this alongside the other Chapter 4 story stamps. Optional activities can wait until the mission is over.

steps.text: Clear Headliners when it comes up in the Chapter 4 main sequence.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: The airport has a separate free-roam trophy. For this stamp, stay with the Chapter 4 main missions.

steps.text: Finish VCIA Takedown in the main story for the automatic unlock.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: I tick this on the final chapter page before the finale stamp. The main mission awards it as you go.

steps.text: Continue Chapter 5 through the end of Operation Savage Glory.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: After the credits, open the game’s own checklist and work by category. Most lists accept a quota, and scans and studies from the story already count. Budget the largest part of the run for this page.

steps.text: Go to Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and note the remaining quotas.
Target 100 optional missions, 200 base vehicles, 100 animals, 15 meditations, 70 challenges, 300 stunts and 100 WAiNK scans.
Finish every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting-range gold, drone race and Bret Target Deck. Consult the journal checklist for the other quotas.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: I batch bridge passes when I need to fill this column quickly. Keep adding checks after the silver because the completion list wants another 50.

steps.text: Mix stunt jumps, bridge passes, knife flights and base jumps until Progress > Activities > Stunts reads 250.
Use Exploration > Stunt Spots to locate extras and reach 300 for completion.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Give each activity its own tick while roaming. A basketball attempt needs a made basket, so check that one before leaving the court.

steps.text: Try fishing, hunting, golf, a range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt.
Check missing categories under Progress > Activities.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Use 42 golds as the number to chase. Range counts differ by source, but the medal target is consistent and the practice raises Focus.

steps.text: Work through all 42 gold medals, grouped into 12 ranges in the PowerPyx and GTABase tallies.
Use the range work to build Focus ahead of Gunslinger.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: One win per site earns the stamp. I finish the remaining time trials while the controls and course are still fresh.

steps.text: Take a win at each of the 14 Top Fun sites.
Record all 42 time trials for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Pick a fresh course each time you win. The trophy arrives at 20 distinct wins, but I leave ten more spaces on the completion page.

steps.text: Win on 20 separate courses and confirm your tally under Progress > Activities > Racing.
Reach 30 wins across the 40 courses for 100%.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Watch for Cal’s text after meeting him in Chapter 1. I bring a boat with a rod so I can start fishing when I reach his marker.

steps.text: After Feng Shui, follow the purple marker west of Key Lento and take Cal’s fishing jobs.
For the challenge, land a Parrotfish weighing more than 2 kg.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Choose one game you enjoy enough to see through to the end. Extra challenge clears can stay off this page.

steps.text: Start Time Jackers Rewind on the home TV or find a game such as Bang For Your Buck in an arcade cabinet.
Clear every level of that one game to get the stamp.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy contacts Lucia in Chapter 3 and sends her to Belville. Keep his errands in order, or leave the whole strand for after the credits.

steps.text: Use Lucia to answer Andy and begin Climbing the Cellerichain, including its three parts.
Follow the fee, Peach! and Read the Label jobs through to Puff Puff Pass.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton gets you into the water early, then may go quiet. Keep a note of the wrecks you have cleared and wait for his later text if the strand pauses.

steps.text: After Island Dreams, use the marked wrecks and metal detector to locate and return Kenton’s seven treasures.
Check Progress > Collections > Kenton’s Treasures and watch for Jason’s follow-up in Chapters 2–3.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: I pencil in the Mudclub once Coffee Break is done. Billy’s thread stays open after the credits, so there is no rush.

steps.text: Visit Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after Coffee Break.
Follow Billy from Thrillbillies through Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: I check the trophy counter after each completed strand. Only part of the qualifying list is confirmed, and this stamp sits outside the game’s 100% checklist.

steps.text: Start with confirmed strands: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete.
Skip Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie when chasing this counter. Check the counter after each other candidate until it reaches eight.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Once Randy hands over his wish list, keep the phone scan handy in Ocean Beach. I take wanted cars west to his garage as I find them.

steps.text: Complete Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS in Chapter 3 to open the 16-car list.
Check sports cars with WAiNK and bring matches to the green RK garage in west Vice City.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Set this page aside for Jason in Chapter 3. The purple lab markers lead to Tyrone’s closing job.

steps.text: After Here, Kitty Kitty, follow Take Out Kitty Litter and clear synthetic labs as Jason.
Finish the lab shutdown when Tyrone offers Spin On This.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: One morning at Jason’s house, Lucia heads out to the balcony. Follow her and take the optional meditation before Chapter 1 ends. The balcony adds a point, but whether it is required for the trophy remains unconfirmed.

steps.text: In Chapter 1, accept Lucia’s balcony invitation at Jason’s house. The scene is unavailable after the chapter.
Visit all 18 marked spots across 10 locations. Track them in Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.
Return for the final spot once you can roam together after Coffee Break. At shared spots, meditating as both characters can add two to the counter.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: I would finish all of Bret’s Target Decks while working on 100%. The exact animal that awards this stamp is still unconfirmed.

steps.text: After Coffee Break, use Jason to answer Bret and begin Veteran Hunted in Lummox County.
Use the assigned hunt markers and retrieve Bret’s Killtelligence SM-69 from an Ammu-Nation locker if needed.
Work through all 15 Target Decks and check when the trophy registers.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Finish the sets that are closest to complete first. Sold cards still count, and the silver comes well before the 100% requirement.

steps.text: Fill any three of the 18 card sets. Pawn shop sales preserve progress.
Continue until 15 sets are done for the completion checklist.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan landmarks and oddities whenever the route takes you past one. The silver and 100% use the same target, so I track them on one line.

steps.text: Open WAiNK by holding Up and pressing R1. Scan landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and No Flusher Tags.
Use Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations to confirm 100 distinct scans.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: I clear the short challenges first and leave the stubborn ones at the back of the book. The bronze appears at 50, twenty short of the completion target.

steps.text: Open Progress > Challenges and complete 50 of the 80 listed tasks.
Raise the total to 70 for 100%, leaving any ten unfinished.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: I leave this for the Chapter 4 vault route, which gives the pair a four-star chase. The trophy checks that you lose the heat with your partner along.

steps.text: After Coffee Break, call your partner with Right and Triangle or go into a Chapter 4 bank vault job together.
At four stars, exit the red pursuit zone with the pair. The Ambrosia train tunnel is one in-game route.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Mark three nearby game targets before bringing your partner. The northern Vice City jewelry stores make it easier to keep the same wanted meter between visits.

steps.text: After Coffee Break, bring your partner to three consecutive green robbery markers with the in-game wanted meter active throughout.
Try the north Vice City cluster after Yasmani’s Jewelry Jobs. Wait roughly 30 seconds after the third exit and try a fourth marker if needed.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: I scan traffic instead of entering every vehicle. Keep going after the bronze because the base-model list for 100% is larger.

steps.text: Enter or WAiNK-scan vehicles until 100 are discovered. A busy roadside offers plenty to scan.
For completion, log 200 of the 277 base models.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Build Focus through range practice before trying this. Gang Operation enemies are the reliable test, and all five takedowns must fit into one activation.

steps.text: Raise Focus toward level 4 and use Adrenaline if you need a longer meter.
While aiming at a gang encounter, press L3 and R3 and down five enemies before that activation expires.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: The departure gates are my first stop for this stamp. Pick an airliner still attached to a boarding bridge and keep flying past the airport boundary.

steps.text: At VCIA, try E3 or E4 and follow the boarding bridge stairs to a docked airliner’s cockpit.
Back the plane out, take off and travel at least a kilometer from VCIA.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Put Mile Zero Air Station on the cleanup page. The in-game Rhinos are parked toward the south end of the base.

steps.text: Drive onto the Mariana County island base through the gate or via the southeast stunt jump.
Enter a Rhino and engage enemies in-game until the trophy registers.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: I wait for Yasmani’s Chapter 3 job to unlock the Snap Gun. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds is a suggested in-game stop for the silent route.

steps.text: Use the Snap Gun on the back door after Yasmani’s Jewelry Jobs. Kicking the door trips the game’s alarm.
Collect the backroom code, loot the safe and use the footage and alarm interactions before leaving.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: The first Chapter 4 vault job opens the rest of this route. Count successful escapes as well as bags collected, and keep the other three vaults on the 100% page.

steps.text: Complete That’s Where The Money Is… with your partner to open the large bank jobs.
Buy Yasmani’s $10,000 security-van tips and clear any five of the eight vault jobs, losing the four-star heat after each.
Record the trophy as silver per the PSN-sourced list.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: I let the Chapter 4 optional vault job cover this stamp. The game credits the job toward the truck trophy once you get clear.

steps.text: Take That’s Where The Money Is… and escape its pursuit. A separate in-game armored truck encounter can also count.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: I save a plane for the last dark strips on the map. The stamp waits until the fog is fully gone.

steps.text: Fly over the remaining blacked-out regions and check the map between passes.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: I keep a tick for each gang, since nine jobs from one group will leave gaps. The completion route eventually takes you through all 39 operations.

steps.text: Use nearby yellow map markers to finish one operation for each of the nine gangs.
Check Progress > Gangs for any group you have missed.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Put Ocean View Rooftop Bar on the Ocean Beach page. PowerPyx documents the specific order and where to drink it.

steps.text: Buy the Apple Martini and drink it on foot next to the rooftop bar.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: I wait until the story hands over the Key Cloner. The stamp is tied to the blue Banshee, and PowerPyx reports a brief delay after leaving.

steps.text: After Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, use the Key Cloner on the blue Banshee in the south Vice City showroom.
Drive it through the display window and continue along the street for the unlock.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Mark three pickups for Kingpin Bowling. You can return after the robbery marker respawns, and the trophy waits until you escape the chase.

steps.text: Visit during Hit Kingpin Bowling in Chapter 2 or return to the Port Gellhorn map marker later.
Collect the southeast office watch, northeast table Gutterball Moreland 850 and northeast hallway safe loot, then lose the in-game pursuit.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: I bring both characters to the gym after Coffee Break. The stamp checks their Strength together, so keep an eye on both heart icons.

steps.text: Buy a fitness-club membership and call your partner along with Right and Triangle for workouts.
Check Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength and top out both characters at the same time.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Leave this one running in the background during the story and robberies. The PS5 trophy detail is a better count than a tally from memory.

steps.text: Enable Criminal Profile messages in Settings > UI > HUD Notifications and accrue 500 actions that affect it.
Read the trophy progress counter before doing any extra cleanup encounters.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Keep this entry for Lucia solo after Credit Check. PowerPyx’s method calls for leaving on foot and giving the trophy time to register.

steps.text: With Lucia alone, visit the Little Cuba Payday Loans after the Chapter 3 unlock and complete the in-game teller robbery.
Run away on foot and keep going while the unlock catches up.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: I circle back if the roadside car fails to appear. This encounter is a solo visit after 2 a.m., and the spawn can take a few attempts.

steps.text: Go northwest of Starlet Motel in Kelly County alone after 2 a.m. and look for a blinking car.
Follow the blue light into the woods, speak with the woman and offer help, then return to the road.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Try this in a crowded part of Vice City or Ocean Beach. PowerPyx gives the bike input and the one-minute window.

steps.text: Use Square for the in-game bike kick and land ten pedestrian hits in 60 seconds.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: I count the money after it reaches a fence. Several jobs can cover the $250,000, and the later vault route contributes much larger payouts.

steps.text: After Credit Check, use the in-game bank and Payday Loans jobs to gather marked bills and bring them to a fence such as Yasmani.
Combine proceeds from multiple jobs. The Chapter 4 vault route can yield up to $205,000 from one job.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Keep an eye on the combined spend while outfitting the characters. Vehicle upgrades, weapons and tattoos help close a remaining gap quickly.

steps.text: Accumulate $100,000 in game shop purchases across your visits. Include upgrades or other expensive items during cleanup.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: I set aside $160,000 for garage purchases. The garages handed out during the story are separate from the eight that cost money.

steps.text: Finish Daily Driver in Chapter 2 to unlock the Vice City Real Estate app.
Use the phone app to buy all eight listed garages, then use the parking slots for On the Spot.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Buy enough garage space before paying registration fees. Cheap cars and bikes make the count easier on the wallet.

steps.text: Unlock Scooter Bros through Moses in Chapter 2. Bring an untracked vehicle to Port Gellhorn and choose Respray, then Register.
From Chapter 3, add Standard Tracker vehicles at Pay ’n’ Spray if needed and log ten registrations.
